items: A cleaner, more polished look throughout the app: refined Material 3 Expressive styling, standardized card shapes, calm reading counters, and harmonized typography across all screens.
Redesigned Reader Experience: Uncluttered, compact header and unified bottom dock that never overlaps controls or obscures verses
Calm Reading Counters: Real-time verses-left counter and chapter indicators that smoothly count down as you read through your daily chapters
Two-Mode App Updater: Choose between updating directly inside the app with instant install on return, or opening the download link in your browser
Persistent Home Update Card: A prominent home screen card appears when an update is downloaded and ready, letting you tap to install anytime
Prayer and Application Sharing: Prayers and Applications can now be sent to church leaders for guidance, with sent and reply timestamps and optional group sharing
Material Expressive Send Animation: Clear visual feedback with animated loading states and confirmation checkmarks when sending notes
Dynamic Home Screen: Smooth, animated expanding cards in priority order that open up space without crowding your dashboard
Scripture Quote Cards: Beautifully styled, branded Scripture quote cards with leadership responses for sharing inspired passages with your community
Notes and Insights Repair: Seamless saving and editing for all note types including private personal Insights
Synchronized Notes Counter: Home screen note counts now reflect all your saved notes instantaneously
Resilient Error Recovery: Helpful messages and offline draft preservation when saving notes
Bible Translations Overhaul: Fixed offline footnote parsing across all 12 New Testament translations
Unified Bible Translations Screen: Single, clear interface showing downloaded versions and live wavy progress indicators during download
Direct Reader Translation Switcher: Switch between your downloaded translations instantly from the reader with the new compact Aa chip
Offline Scripture Engine: Resilient offline bundles allow continuous scripture reading without requiring an internet connection
Community and Leadership Answers: Inspiring reflections and questions answered by leaders now appear directly on your home feed
ForgeHouse Announcements: Official programme announcements and updates now displayed prominently on the home screen
Interactive Scripture Pickers: Convenient book, chapter, and verse pickers when writing and attaching notes to scripture
Community Play Store Support: In-app support card to help support ForgeHouse 50 on the Google Play Store
Continuous Chapter Reading: Read smoothly across multiple assigned chapters in one continuous scroll
Chapter Progress and Position Restore: The reader remembers your exact scroll position and chapter so you can resume right where you left off
Clear Verse-Level Section Headings: Authentic scripture headings now display cleanly above corresponding verses
Active Reading Timer: Offline-safe timer tracks your 5-minute active reading goal with encouragement and pause indicators
Dynamic Animated Pill Navigation: Modern animated floating pill bar with smooth horizontal swipe gestures between tabs
Edge-to-Edge Reading Experience: Full-height reading view maximizing scripture text visibility on all screen sizes
Observations and Questions Sent to Leaders: Church leadership receives your observations and questions with optional anonymity
Custom Profile Pictures: Choose and personalize your avatar with integrated crop and zoom tools
Offline Reading Timer and 5-Minute Minimum: Accurately tracks reading duration and unlocks day completion after 5 minutes and final chapter
Responsive Small-Screen Scaling: Adaptive typography and fluid margins optimized for compact mobile screens
Forgot Password Recovery: Reset your password securely via 6-digit email verification codes
In-App Version Alerts: Automatic notifications when new programme features and bug fixes become available
Automatic Scripture Context: New notes automatically pre-fill the book, chapter, and verse you are currently reading
